reason: Expert reports that a firmware upgrade resets ATPC on microwave links and advises checking it after upgrades.

knowledge.summary: The 1.4 firmware upgrade resets ATPC to off on microwave links, leading to link fading in rainy weather; check and re-enable ATPC after upgrading.
knowledge.author: Jari Jänne
knowledge.details: Firmware 1.4 upgrade resets ATPC setting to off.
